Employment shares by economic sector in Swiss cities

pv_city_sectors.Rd

Share of employees (percent) in each NOGA 2008 economic section, per Swiss city. Naturally hierarchical (city → sector) — good for treemaps, sunbursts, and heatmaps.

Usage

pv_city_sectors

Format

A data frame: city, sector_code (NOGA section letter A–S), sector, share (percent of the city's employees).

Source

Bundesamt für Statistik (BFS), Statistik der Unternehmensstruktur STATENT, via stats.swiss. Open use, source citation required.
